This exorbitant pricing offers a negative margin of safety of -842.9% [E35], with a discounted cash flow valuation pegging intrinsic value at a mere Rs 13 per share against a market price of Rs 124 [E34]. Compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months sits at a dismal -100% [E14], profitability is heavily propped up by non-operating sources including Rs 1.83 Cr in other income [E49], and the business generates negative operating cash flow of Rs -0.69 Cr alongside a free cash flow deficit of Rs -1.92 Cr for Mar 2026 [E24, E25]. Return metrics are severely depressed, with an ROE of 0.7% [E13] and ROCE of 0.7% [E10] trailing far behind sector medians, culminating in a rules-based screen score of just 22 out of 100 resulting in a medium-confidence sell rating [E50]. However, the bear's focus on historical P/E ignores the explosive profit inflection underway, evidenced by a massive 1150% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months and profit increasing quarter-over-quarter [E15, E51]. This earnings momentum is directly beginning to outperform expectations, with profit growth exceeding 1-year price growth by 1218% [E46]. This robust financial health provides immense safety while the massive ₹ 120.17 Cr tied up in Capital Work in Progress (CWIP) remains steady to fuel future operational expansion [E30]. Finally, the bull dismisses the reverse DCF risk, yet the market price demands an aggressive 41.9% earnings growth rate which directly contradicts decelerating earnings trends and a rules-based screen score of only 22 out of 100 [E36, E50, E54].
